# Voice profile: Riley Example
2026-10-20 · built from 0 pieces · confidence low

## Tone
Warm and direct (a default from stated preferences).

## Do
- Write in a warm, direct first person.
- Say the point in the first line.
- Keep paragraphs to one or two lines.
- End with one plain question.

## Don't
- No listicles or numbered 'top 5' formats.
- No hype words (game-changer, revolutionary, thrilled).
- No exclamation marks.

## Words we use / words we avoid
Avoid: game-changer, revolutionary, thrilled

## Openings and closings
The point first; one plain question at the end.

## Emoji and hashtags
None; at most one hashtag.

## Platform notes
- LinkedIn (default): short paragraphs.
- X (default): one post.

## Example openers (new, not copied)
- Here is what changed this week, and why it matters to you.
- One thing I got wrong this month.
